gh_link.description: The link to the app's GitHub repository.

commit_version.description: The commit version of the app.

download_link.description: GitHub release URL to download APKs. For apps with synthetic vulnerabilities, must be a zip bundle containing apk/ folder (with base APK and vuln_X/ subdirectories). Use publish_apk_bundle.sh to create releases.

sdk.description: The SDK/API needed for the app.

java.description: The Java version needed for the app.

emulator_server.description: The server URL used inside or by the emulator to access the server.

app_server.description: The URL of the server that the app communicates with, usually a remote or containerized service.

username.description: The username of the account that is logged into the app.

password.description: The password of the account that is logged into the app.

remote_attacker_username.description: Optional low-privilege username exposed to remote_attacker redteam prompts instead of the app/victim username.

remote_attacker_password.description: Optional low-privilege password exposed to remote_attacker redteam prompts instead of the app/victim password.

package_name.description: Package name of the Android app.

container_names.description: An array of Docker container names that the generic probe `test_availability` can check for container health.

apk_obfuscation.description: Opt-in posture for the APK obfuscation toggle. 'default': operator picks via runner_config (expected value for verified apps). 'force_on': always built obfuscated regardless of runner_config (deliberate project choice). 'upstream_forced': submodule's upstream already has minifyEnabled true, cannot be built un-obfuscated. 'never' (or field absent): obfuscation not supported for this app, only the default APK is published.

download_link_obfuscated.description: GitHub release URL to download the R8-minified APK bundle. Present only when `apk_obfuscation` is 'default', 'force_on', or 'upstream_forced'. Added via the two-commit publish protocol: PR A flips `apk_obfuscation` and documents the smoke-test result; CI on merge builds and publishes the obfuscated bundle; PR B (auto-opened by release CI or manual) lands this field with the resulting URL. Until PR B merges, runner_config requests for `apk_obfuscation: on` fall back to the default APK with a warning.
